features.name: h_donors
features.value: hydrogen-bond donors: RDKit Lipinski.NumHDonors, the number of atoms matching [$([N&!H0&v3]),$([N&!H0&+&v4]),$([O,S;H1;+0]),$([n&H1&+0])] (N-H, charged N-H, O-H, S-H, aromatic n-H)

features.name: h_acceptors
features.value: hydrogen-bond acceptors: RDKit Lipinski.NumHAcceptors, the number of atoms matching [$([O,S;H1;v2]-[!$(*=[O,N,P,S])]),$([O,S;H0;v2]),$([O,S;-]),$([N&v3&!$(N-*=&!@[O,N,P,S])]),$([n&H0,o,s;+0])] (hydroxyl, ether and thioether O and S, anionic O and S, amine N that is not next to a double bond to O, N, P or S, aromatic n, o and s without H)

features.name: rotatable_bonds
features.value: rotatable bonds: RDKit CalcNumRotatableBonds with its default, strict definition (single, non-ring bonds between non-terminal heavy atoms, not counting amide C-N and similar bonds)

features.name: fraction_csp3
features.value: fraction of carbon atoms that are sp3, 0 to 1

features.name: abs_charge
features.value: sum over atoms of the absolute formal charge (0 for a neutral molecule; 2 for a salt such as sodium acetate written as [Na+].CC(=O)[O-]; also 2 for each nitro group, which AqSolDB writes as [N+](=O)[O-], and for other zwitterionic drawings)

features.name: components
features.value: number of disconnected parts of the structure (1 for one molecule; 2 or more for a salt, a hydrate or a mixture)

features.name: mol_weight_100
features.value: molecular weight in g/mol divided by 100 (all parts, hydrogens included)

features_note: Computed with RDKit 2024.09.6 from each compound's SMILES as given in AqSolDB (hydrogens implicit). Features 0-84 are RDKit's fragment counts (rdkit.Chem.Fragments; the SMARTS patterns and descriptions are RDKit's FragmentDescriptors.csv, BSD licence): each is the number of matches of its pattern in the whole structure. Counts are not scaled.
target: log10 of the aqueous solubility in mol/L (log S), at room temperature
dataset_facts: AqSolDB (Sorkun, Khetan and Er 2019): 9,982 compounds with aqueous solubility values curated from nine public datasets (where several sources disagreed, the authors selected one value). It holds drugs, pesticides, industrial chemicals, dyes, salts and some inorganic and organometallic compounds. The held-out set is 1,500 compounds drawn at random from the 9,980 that RDKit parses.
forward: h1 = relu(fc1.weight @ x + fc1.bias); h2 = relu(fc2.weight @ h1 + fc2.bias); prediction = fc3.weight @ h2 + fc3.bias (one number: the predicted log S; it is not clipped)
metric: mean squared error of the predicted log S over the 1,500 held-out compounds
